name: Confounding Flash
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
A priest recently visited our halls seeking you out, young friend. He said that he was on a mission to find you and that you should return to the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge as soon as possible. When you arrive, seek out High Priestess Mims--she will tell you more.

The Light be with you, adventurer.
narrative.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText: You took your time arriving, adventurer. But you can be excused given your dedicated service to the Light. Please pay close attention to this lesson.
